'''Hector Leak''' [[CBE]] (23 July 1887 – 5 April 1976) was a British statistician.  He was appointed a CBE in 1942.<ref>‘LEAK, Hector’, Who Was Who, A & C Black, an imprint of Bloomsbury Publishing plc, 1920–2008; online edn, Oxford University Press, Dec 2007 [http://www.ukwhoswho.com/view/article/oupww/whowaswho/U156628 accessed 23 July 2013]</ref> He was also the president of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] during a short period in 1941. Awarded the silver [[Guy Medal]] in 1940.
